answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks using directional optical mesh authentication. Each node along a river basin or mountain ridge verifies its physical presence by steering laser links through a refracting prism to complete synchronous cryptographic handshakes. An adversary incurs steep capital and line-of-sight siting costs for every transceiving device deployed per identity. However, dense fog and particulate scattering degrade beam coherence, falsely disconnecting honest agents.
